items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And my mother, I didn't say my mother's name, was Marceline LeBlanc.

ctx.x: Edna B. Senegal. Wait, I want my full name. This is Edna Bibelet Serena Senegal. That's my children's name, Serena. And I tell them about this tape. And Mother, you didn't put our name on there. You put an S. And it's Serena. Serena is the Spanish part of our family. So we should have Serena. This is my second marriage in Senegal. Our first marriage was to Serena. And he was the one that his grandfather came from Spain. So it's my children's grandfather. Great grandfather, see. And, uh, of course, French, came…
And I'm Dick Allen. I want to put our own names on here so that everybody will know what's what. Who's who. Who's who's going on. Who's who.
